text:
I was teaching my nephew how to play kickball at recess. He is only five but he runs super fast. We were on the big field and the sun was hot. Suddenly the ball went flying into the scary woods.

"I am not going in there!" yelled my nephew.

I sighed and walked to the trees to find it. The leaves were scattered all over the muddy ground. I looked for thirteen minutes but I saw nothing. Then I saw a shiny blue thing like a jewel. It was just an old candy wrapper.

"Did you find it?" he asked me.

"No, it is gone to kickball heaven," I said.

We went back to class when we heard the knock on the door. It was the teacher with our ball! I felt like I could bungee jump with happiness. We play there often now.

I was playing my favorite video game about boating. I was wearing my lucky hat and yearning to win. The game was loading really slow, so I grumbled. Finally, my boat was following the big red ship. I squeezed the controller super hard.

"Don't crash into the rocks!" my brother yelled at me.

"I know what I am doing!" I shouted back.

Suddenly my boat flew in the air and landed on the ground. I discovered a secret shortcut behind a big tree. I swam my boat fast to the finish line. I won the race and didn't have to go to the hospital in the game.

"Next time I am beating you," said my brother.

We had a meeting about who plays next.

I trained for the big race all week. It was at summer camping and I wanted to win. My friend Sam said it was dangerous but I wasn't scared. I sprinted fast and I ran past the big tree. Then I threw a water balloon at the target to complete the obstacle course. 

"You are going too fast!" yelled Sam.

"I am going to win!" I shouted back.

I jumped on the bungee trampoline and bounced high. I felt like a superhero flying in the air. I crossed the finish line first and everyone cheered for me. Then I was very hungry so I ate a hot dog. I read the camp newspaper later. It said I was the fastest runner ever. I can't wait to race again tomorrow.

My friend Tim and I woke up very early. It was a cold Saturday in February. We wanted to find the lost treasure in the woods. We put on our big coats and ran outside.

"Look at that big mountain!" Tim yelled loudly.

We climbed up the hill and the path cleared. Suddenly, a big dog jumped out at us. It looked like a monster but it was nice. I grasped Tim’s hand because I was scared.

"Maybe the dog is a knight guarding the gold," I said.

The dog grabbed a stick and ran away fast. We kept walking and found a shiny box. I held it tight and used my brain to open it. It was already empty! We laughed and went home for lunch.

Yesterday I played a big video game with my brother. We had to find a golden elephant in the jungle. I searched everywhere for it but it was super hard.

"Where is it?" I screamed at the TV screen.

My brother laughed and he threw a virtual rock at me. I felt anger because he was winning the game. I heard a loud noise and saw my character bumping into a tree. Then I saw something shiny under a newspaper on the ground.

"I found it!" I said and used my knife to dig.

It was not the elephant but it was a magic comb. I thought the game was broken so I turned it off. We did not complete the level but it was still fun.

I was so excited for the big soccer game today. I am the captain of my team, the Tigers. My mom was bringing my lucky red socks. But then I saw a giant purple stain on them! My dog Buster chewed them up and they looked terrible. I was so mad I stewed about it all morning.

"I can't play without my lucky socks!" I screamed.

"They are just socks, you will be fine," said Mom.

The sun scorched the grass on the field. The game was longer than usual and very hot. I kicked the ball hard and scored a goal! It was an incredible shot right into the net. We won the important game even without my socks. I guess I don't need them to be a winner.

My brother Max and I woke up very early today. We wanted to be the greatest explorers ever. We packed our bags and moved quietly outside. Max brought his toy sword because he is trained to fight monsters.

Suddenly we heard a loud noise tearing through the bushes. I was scared but Max was thrilled.

"Do you think it is a dragon?" I whispered.

Max turned around and said, "Get your rope ready to wrap it up!"

We saw a shadow growing bigger and bigger. We jumped out and yelled! But it was just a tiny white lamb. It looked lost so we took it home. It was the best adventure.

On Wednesday, me and my friend Max went on a big adventure. We found a dark cave behind the school playground. Max feared the dark, but I did not. We scrambled over some big rocks and reached the opening. Inside, shiny coins were scattered all over the floor!

"Wow, look at all this gold!" Max shouted.

Suddenly, a giant spider jumped down to guard the treasure. I threw a rock at it, and it ran away. Max grinned and tried to seize a handful of coins. Then the ground shook, and we lost gravity for a second. We floated up!

"Let’s get out of here!" I yelled.

We swept up some coins and ran back outside fast. That was just the beginning of our fun day.

My cousin and I were playing a dangerous new video game. We picked the jungle level because it looked scary. My player was roaming around looking for bad guys. Suddenly a big creature jumped out and I started trembling.

"Watch out for the green monster!" yelled my cousin.

I grabbed my controller tight and my hands were sweaty. My character threw a rock but the monster twisted away. Then the gravity got weird and I started floating up. I was clinging to a tree branch so I didn't fly away.

"You are going to get roasted by his fire!" he laughed.

But I found a special sword with a secret meaning. I hit the monster and won the level fast. My little nephew watched us play in our apartment. It was the best game ever.

My neighbor Tim and I went to the spooky mountain. It was the beginning of our big quest. We saw a cave and crawled inside carefully. The ceiling was very dark and scary.

"Look at that shiny thing on the ground!" Tim screamed.

I grinned and walked to the shiny gold rock. Suddenly a big bear jumped out. The scene was super scary.

"Run away fast or it will be a failure!" I yelled.

We ran out and escaped the bear by jumping over logs. We felt stronger and brave. The height of the mountain was huge but we were safe. We went home and had snacks.

One day I went to the zoo with my dad. We paid for tickets and walked inside. I saw a huge gray animal roaming in the grass.

"Look at that big nose!" I said.

My dad laughed and told me it was an elephant. Suddenly we heard a loud noise sounding like a trumpet. The elephant was approaching the fence fast! I thought it escaped from its cage.

"Run away!" I screamed.

But the elephant just wanted some peanuts. It was incredible to see up close. Later we saw seals and they swam in blue water. It was the best day ever.

I thought today was going to be a normal day. I ate my breakfast and ran to catch the bus. But then I saw something weird in the school yard. It looked like a lamb, but it grew really big!

It struck me that maybe I was still asleep. I froze and just stared at the animal. Then my friend Tommy reached over and poked me.

"Is that a sheep?" Tommy asked me.

"To be honest, it looks like a monster," I said.

Suddenly the animal started running toward the jungle gym. We crawled under the slide so we wouldn't get caught. I counted to ten and peeked out. The animal was gone! It was so strange. Then the bell rang and we had to go receive our homework. I hope nobody asks me about the giant lamb.

I was walking home from school and I heard a loud knock. Suddenly a big green ship appeared right on the grass. The door opened and a robot walked straight out. He was holding a glowing rock that lit up the whole street. I had a really bad feeling and I was scared.

"Take me to your leader on Earth," the robot spoke.

"I don't know who that is!" I screamed back.

Then a little alien came out steering a floating chair. He looked like a king ready to reign over us. I almost fainted right there on the sidewalk. But then my dog barked and they got scared and escaped back into the sky.

I have a robot named Sparky. He is made of shiny metal and bounced around my room. Sparky loves science and speaking about space. One day, Sparky found a big painting of a blue alien. He was afraid because the alien had three eyes.

"Don’t be scared, Sparky," I said. "It is just art."

Sparky beeped and held up a soft feather. He tickled the painting and we laughed for an hour. Then we tried to climb the bookshelf to see the stars. Sparky fell down, though. He did not break. He said he knows robot psychology, so he felt happy again fast. Being friends with a robot is the best fun ever.

One Wednesday in February, me and my friend Sam went exploring. We walked up the big mountain behind my house. It was very steep and the height was scary. We wanted to find the secret magic fountain at the top.

"Look at that cave!" Sam shouted at me.

We went inside and it was dark and cold. Suddenly we heard a loud whistle sound. It was a giant bear guarding the water! We ran fast and cleared the path to get away.

"That was too close," I said.

We didn't find the fountain but earning our safety was important. We went home to play a game on the computer instead. The game was loading slow but we didn't care. It was better than getting eaten by a bear!

I was running in the woods behind my house. The leaves were growing big and green on the trees. I saw a weird bug floating near a flower. I started to look closer at it.

"Don't touch it!" yelled my brother Sam. "It is a stinging bee!"

I pushed him away playfully. "I want to learn about it."

Sam drew a picture of the bug in the dirt. We watched the bee spread its wings. Suddenly, a big dog came approaching us fast. It crushed the dirt picture with its paw.

"Who is bearing down on us?" I asked.

The dog sniffed my shoe. It looked hungry. I had some stewed beef in my pocket from lunch. I gave it to the dog. He ate it and gravity pulled him down to sleep. We made a new friend.

My dog Barnaby loves riding in my dad's truck. He sits in the front seat like a furry person. We were driving to the park for a picnic. The breeze felt nice coming through the open window. It was a beautiful sunny day for exploring outside.

Barnaby put his paws on the wheel like he was steering. Dad laughed and said, "Look at Colonel Barnaby driving us!"

I laughed too and Barnaby barked at a squirrel. We finally got to the big green park. Mom was waiting for us by the swings with lunch. She played her guitar and everyone sang songs. Then Barnaby chased a ball and brought it back again. He is the best dog in the whole world.

We were having a huge sleepover for my birthday. All my friends came over early to play. We crawled into my fort made of blankets. It was dark inside and we felt a little scared. Then my brother jumped out and screeched loudly! We were trapped inside and he was laughing.

"Stop it, you are being mean!" I yelled.

He grinned and said, "I knew you were scared."

My mom came in bearing a tray of snacks. She taught us how to make shadow puppets together. We stayed up late and had too much caffeine. I love keeping secrets in our fort and telling jokes. I had a funny feeling in my tummy from growing too fast. It was the best birthday ever.

I brought a toasted cheese sandwich for lunch today. It is usually my favorite food to eat at school. But today I discovered something very bad inside my lunchbox. The cheese was cold and it tasted like rubber.

"Ew, this tastes gross!" I said to my friend Sam.

Sam looked at my sandwich and stuck out his tongue. "I guarantee my mom packed me something better," he said.

He had scrambled eggs in a thermos, but he chewed loudly. It was not a pleasant sound to hear while eating. I decided to eat my apple instead. After lunch, we played soccer and Mr. Jones was coaching us. It was a pleasure to score a goal finally! Then the bell rang and we ran back inside.

I was playing my favorite car racing video game. My hands gripped the controller super tight. I wanted to be the champion of the whole world. My car was blue and looked like a painting.

"Go faster!" my brother yelled at the screen.

I pressed the button and my car zoomed to the left. I swept past the red car and took the lead. I felt thrilled and started jumping up and down. But then my car crashed into a wall. It was bad.

"Oh no! You lost your speed," my brother said.

I remembered a trick and used a boost. I spread my fingers out to seize the win. I crossed the finish line first! I was so grateful. My mom said I had too much energy like I had caffeine. I tried to maintain my cool, but I was bearing a huge smile.

One day my friend Leo and I went on an adventure. We walked deep into the jungle to find a lost treasure. Suddenly, a huge wind blew and the trees started shaking. We heard a loud ringing noise near a big cave.

"What is that scary noise?" asked Leo.

We crawled inside the dark cave and saw a baby elephant! His foot was stuck under a heavy rock. I felt sorry for him so I grabbed a big stick. Leo and I pushed the rock and threw it away. The elephant was so grateful and happy. He picked us up with his trunk. We were swinging in the air and laughing.

"This is the best day ever!" I shouted.

We didn't find the gold treasure but we were thrilled anyway. We made a new friend and that was better.

I was in my treehouse doing a science project. My nephew Billy was helping me mix green slime. Suddenly a big purple ship landed in the yard. Leaves scattered everywhere and the tree was trembling. An alien came out and he looked hungry.

"Do you want some toast?" asked Billy loudly.

The alien made a weird moaning sound.

I ran to the kitchen and toasted some bread. I already brewed some hot chocolate too. We gave the food to the alien and he ate it fast. He smiled and got back in his ship. He was leaving but he waved goodbye first.

"That was cool," I said to Billy.

We went back to making slime.

We were roaming through the old woods near my apartment. My friend Leo pushed a big branch out of the way. We were looking for the haunted shed.

"Did you hear that groaning sound?" Leo asked me.

"Maybe it is just a ghost," I said bravely.

We crossed a small river and reached the creepy shed. It had a weird design on the door. I saw something roaming inside! A bat flew out and we screamed. We ran until we saw thirteen stairs. We climbed them and were safe.

"That was scary but fun," Leo said.

My dog chewed on a stick and wagged his tail. We felt like we were meeting a real monster today. It was a very different adventure than usual.

My best friend Sam came over to my apartment for a sleepover. We decided to bake cookies for my mom because she was sad. I grabbed the big bowl and scrambled some eggs inside.

"Where is the butter?" Sam asked me.

"I think it is near the scissors," I said.

We found the butter and used a dull knife to cut it. We mixed it all for an hour. The smell went throughout the whole kitchen. We put them in the oven but we forgot the timer.

Suddenly, smoke blew out of the oven! The cookies were totally scorched black. My mom ran in and saw the mess.

"Are you boys okay?" she yelled.

We nodded. She laughed and showed us the receipt for pizza. We ate pizza instead and used our imagination that the burnt cookies were moon rocks in a meadow. It was the best night ever.

I was playing a soccer game and I really wanted to win. My friend Sam was on the other team and he is fast. I ate a protein bar before the game for energy. I chewed it quickly but I got a stain on my shirt.

Suddenly the ball appeared right in front of my feet. I ran fast like a breeze and kicked it super hard. It cleared the goalie's head and went right into the net! It felt like finding a shiny jewel.

"Did you use your hands?" Sam asked me and looked mad.

"I promise to be honest, I didn't touch it," I said.

I tried to explain but he just walked away to comb his hair. I was happy because I got to seize the win!

My best friend Tim came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to stay up late, but my mom had a schedule. We went to the basement because it was freezing down there. Tim said, "Maybe a ghost lives in your ceiling." I laughed and said, "Neither of us believes in ghosts!"

We started painting pictures of monsters and aliens on big paper. Suddenly, the lights went out and we both got scared. I thought about scary stories and almost fainted right there. Tim shined a flashlight and caught me hiding under a blanket. He counted to three and then jumped out to scare me. We laughed so hard that my throat felt scorched. Mom came down and checked us for pneumonia because we were cold. Then we went to sleep and dreamed about foreign lands.

It was my best friend Sam’s birthday party yesterday. We went to a big park with giant slides. Everyone held their presents and waited for Sam to open them.

"This is the best party ever!" yelled Sam loudly.

Sam’s mom told us we could play a new game. We followed her to a big bouncy castle. It looked simply amazing and we all jumped inside. I tried to do a single flip but it was a failure. Sam pretended he was doing a bungee jump off the side.

After that, we sat down for cake and reading cards. Sam got treated like a king and felt very special.

"I hope I don't get pneumonia from sweating!" I joked.

The party was complete when we ate all the cake. I am waiting for my birthday to come soon too.

For my birthday party I invited my best friend Sam. We were turning eight on the same day which is weird. We started running in the backyard and swinging on the big swing.

"Watch me go super high!" Sam yelled at me.

We played tag together until we got really tired. Then we went inside for pizza and cake. My mom said I have to maintain my room clean. But we made a mess with all the toys again.

"I am not sleeping on the floor," said Sam.

So we put our sleeping bags on my bed. Seeing my friend happy made me happy too. It was the best birthday ever.

On Wednesday, my dog Buster and I went exploring outside. We walked to the big woods surrounding our house. Buster started sniffing and then he ran off fast. I had to run and search for him everywhere. Then I heard him screaming near the old creek.

"Buster, where are you?" I yelled really loud.

"Woof! Woof!" he barked back from a deep hole.

He had crashed into a ditch and struggled to climb out. The dirt was too slippery and wet. I tried to pull him, but I wasn't strong enough. I needed help fast. I blew my loud whistle three times. My dad came running.

"Don't worry, we are loading him up," Dad said.

We cleared away some branches with scissors. Then we pulled Buster out and left for home. He was safe!

Yesterday my friends and I went to a scary island. We took a small boat and the water was rough. Suddenly a big wave hit us and I fell out! I swam really fast to the sandy ground. I was clinging to a rock because I feared the sharks. My friend Tom grabbed my hand and pulled me up.

"Are you okay?" Tom asked with his eyes closed tight.

"Yes but I lost my backpack," I said sadly.

We walked into the jungle and heard a loud noise. It sounded like a mad elephant roaring in anger. The sound was growing louder and louder. We ran away fast but vines caught my leg. I used my scissors to cut them and we escaped. It was the best adventure ever!

Me and my best friend Sam played a cool video game together. It was called Jungle Racer and it had fast cars. We picked the level with the big green trees. It looked like a real jungle with monkeys everywhere.

"I bet I can beat you this time," Sam said.

"No way, I am the best driver," I told him.

The race started and I pushed the gas button hard. My car jumped over a huge river like we were boating. But then Sam grabbed a power-up and went super fast. It was like he had zero gravity! I tried to catch him but I couldn't contain my car. I pulled the controller back but I crashed into a rock. Sam won every single race that day. I believed I could win, but he was too good. Maybe I need some coaching from my big brother. Next time I will win everything!

I was so excited for recess today. I sprinted outside and my friend Sam was there. We wanted to play chase but first we ate our snack. My mom packed me a bar with lots of protein. It tasted okay but it was very chewy. 

"Let's go play on the big slide!" Sam yelled.

We ran over but everyone was bumping into each other. I saw a kid clinging to the ladder because he was scared. I understood why because it is very high up. 

Suddenly, I felt something in my pocket. It was my small safety scissors from art class! I forgot to put them away. I ran back to the teacher and gave them to her. She smiled at me.

"Thanks for being honest," she said.

Then I went back to play and seize the day. We pretended to bungee jump off the swings until the bell rang.

It was my birthday sleepover and everyone was so excited. We built a huge fort in the living room using blankets. But then my dog Buster ran right through the middle! 

"Oh no! We are trapped!" yelled my friend Jake. 

We simply laughed and started fixing the walls again. It was freezing outside, so we were happy to be inside. Later, we had a dance contest in our pajamas. I moved to the rhythm of the music like a champion. Unfortunately, Jake tripped on a pillow and fell down. 

"Are you okay?" I asked him, leading him to the couch. 

He was fine, but he struggled to get back up. Soon we were all sleeping in our cozy fort. We ended up leaving the mess for the morning because we were too tired. It was the best birthday ever.

I had the greatest sleepover ever last weekend. My best friend Sam came over and we met in my room. We moved my bed so we could see the ceiling better. We put glow stars all over it.

"Look, that one is falling!" Sam yelled loudly.

We caught the star before it hit the floor. Then we started loading up on snacks. My mom said no caffeine but we drank soda anyway. Later my stomach was groaning so loud.

"I think I’m growing a monster inside," I said.

Sam believed me and got scared. It was a funny scene. We stayed up all night talking. It was the best night.

I was walking in the woods and I saw a robot. He looked sad and he was searching for something. I walked carefully up to him and touched his arm. Suddenly a green light appeared and he started jumping up and down!

"Thank you for touching the button!" the robot beeped loudly.

"You are welcome, but what do you eat?" I asked him.

He said he needed a special protein bar from Mars. It seemed impossible to find one but I had a granola bar. He ate it and made a wonderful buzzing sound. He was very grateful and greeted me with a high five. Then he zoomed away into the sky. I hope he stays out of trouble in space.

My friends and I had a big sleepover last Saturday. We were wearing our matching pajamas with blue stars. We wanted to build a huge pillow fort in the living room. It looked like a giant mountain of blankets and pillows.

"Put that cushion over here," said my friend Sarah.

"Okay, but hold it steady or it will fall," I said.

I feared it would crash, but it stayed up. We bounced inside and pretended a tiny gnat was a monster. But then my brother came in and jumped on it. Everything fell down and went wrong! We were mad at him, but then mom brought pizza. We ate the pizza and built the fort again.

We went camping for my brother’s big birthday. He turned thirteen today and he was very bossy. We were climbing a big hill and my legs hurt.

"Hurry up you slow turtle!" my brother screamed.

I grumbled because he was bringing way too much stuff. His backpack was huge and heavy like gravity was pulling it. Suddenly we saw a squirrel and my sister screeched loudly. The squirrel ran up a tree very fast.

"Stop making noise or we won't see bears," Dad said.

We finally got to the top for our meeting spot. We ate cake and it was squished but tasted good. I like camping but I don't like climbing big hills. Next time I am staying in the tent.

My friends and I went climbing up the big green hill. We wanted to find a secret cave near the top. Sam said he saw a single red light there last night. We walked for a long time and my legs grew tired. Suddenly, we discovered a dark hole in the rocks.

"Do you think an alien lives inside?" asked Sam.

I wrote a note in my notebook for science class. We heard a loud noise and something screeched at us. A weird creature was approaching fast with a long blue tongue! It looked very foreign and scary.

"Run away before it eats us for protein!" I yelled.

We ran back down and then we roasted marshmallows at home. That was the scariest adventure ever.

Yesterday was the best day at school. It was freezing outside, but we still went to recess. My friend Sam had a big plan for us. We were going to build a snow mountain.

"We need more snow!" yelled Sam loudly.

I started steering a giant snowball across the playground. It got super heavy, although I kept pushing it hard. We worked throughout the whole break to make it huge.

Suddenly, the teacher blew her whistle immediately. That meant recess was over.

"We can finish it tomorrow," I said to Sam.

We are in a snow fort league now. We didn't finish the mountain, but it was still fun. I was so tired after school.

My younger sister had a birthday party on Saturday. Mom woke us up early and moved the big table outside. The breeze was nice and cool in the yard. My sister was thrilled because all her friends came over. They ran around and threw balloons at each other.

"Stop running near the cake!" Mom yelled loudly.

I brought out the presents and counted them all. There were ten big boxes sitting on the grass. Suddenly, the dog crashed through the decorations. He was bearing a muddy stick in his mouth.

"Oh no, look at the mess!" I grumbled.

We crawled under the table to catch him. My sister laughed so hard she cried. Then Mom found a needle and popped a balloon by mistake. It was the best party ever.

I was eating my breakfast when my dog Max escaped. He ran right out the door and into the woods. I felt anger because I wanted to watch cartoons. I grabbed my shoes and scrambled after him.

Max was hanging around an old building made of wood. It looked scary but I used my imagination. Maybe it was a castle for bears?

"Max! Come here right now!" I yelled loud.

He shook his fur and barked at a squirrel. He did not listen to me at all.

"If you don't come, I am leaving!" I shouted again.

Finally he ran back to me. I paid him with a treat when we got home. Next time I will lock the big door tight.

Yesterday at recess I was swinging super high on the swings. My shoe almost flew straight off my foot! I jumped off and started running to the slide. Then I saw a weird sign near the bushes. It said "Do Not Open" but the wind blew it over.

"What is in there?" asked my friend Sam.

"Maybe it is a secret treasure," I said.

We opened the big box and a hamster escaped! It ran fast like it was scorched by fire. We searched everywhere for him. We finally found him cleaning his face under a bench. We drew a map to find his cage again. The teacher used a thread to fix the cage door so he would stay inside. It was hard to contain him because he was wild. It was the best recess ever.

I was at recess playing tag near the big building. Suddenly a huge gnat appeared right in front of my face. It looked like an invisible monster but I could see it. I twisted my body to get away from the bug.

"Get away from me!" I screamed very loud.

My friend Leo ran over to guard me from the bug. He gripped his lunchbox like a shield and struck the air. The sun scorched our backs because it was super hot outside.

"Did it bite you with a stinging tail?" Leo asked.

I was jumping up and down because I was scared. The bug flew away and disappeared into the trees quickly. We did not want to make a big scene. We went back to class to wrap up our math homework.

My nephew Ben came over to help with homework. He is in high school and drinks lots of caffeine. I struggled with my math and started moaning.

"This is like climbing a huge mountain!" I yelled.

Ben laughed and scratched his head. "It's just numbers, though."

We worked for eight minutes and then I got hungry. Mom made me a sandwich and it was toasted. I discovered a pickle inside and stewed about it. I hate pickles! I threw the pickle through the air.

"Watch out for gravity!" Ben shouted.

The pickle hit the floor with a splat. It was in danger of being eaten by the dog. I started groaning because now I had to clean it up. Homework is the worst.

I was wearing my favorite blue sweater at recess. It is very soft and warm. I saw a loose thread on the sleeve. I started pulling it just a little bit. The thread grew longer and longer. Suddenly, I heard a loud rip! The hole rose up my arm fast. Oh no! I knew my mom would be mad.

My friend Sam ran over to me.
"Did you break your sweater?" he asked loudly.
"Yes, I think I ruined it," I said sadly.

I was yearning for the bell to ring. Then I could hide it in my backpack. I heard a knock on the playground door. It was time to go inside for math. I hope nobody sees the big hole.

Max and I walked to the old spooky house. We knew nobody lived there anymore. The door was closed but I gave a loud knock.

"Hello? Is anybody home?" I yelled very loud.

Nobody answered so we went inside the dark room. It smelled like someone brewed old tea. Suddenly we saw a giant rat gnaw on a chair. Max started stamping his feet and jumping around.

"Look at that scary rat!" Max screamed at me.

We ran into a room that looked like a science lab. There was a big machine with a steering wheel. A sharp needle pointed to red. We were scared so we ran back outside fast. We are never going back there again.

My neighbor Sam came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to go camping in the backyard. My dad helped us set up the big tent. It took a lot of strength to hammer the stakes. Then we played a computer game inside the tent.

"This is good training for the wild," Sam said.

We pretended the garden hose was a dangerous snake. We made a trail with glow sticks to the house. Suddenly my zipper got stuck and I was trapped!

"I can be your guide!" yelled Sam.

He used a tiny needle from a sewing kit to fix it. We stayed up late talking about school tomorrow. It was the best sleepover ever.

One day my friends and I went to the spooky forest. We heard a loud noise and we were scared. It sounded like a monster but we kept walking. Suddenly a giant bird flew down and screeched at us!

"Run away fast!" shouted my friend Timmy.

The bird had a beautiful blue feather on its head. It blew a big wind at us and we almost fell. I grabbed a stick and threw it at the bird. It broke on a tree but the bird got scared.

"That was impossible!" I screamed happily.

We feared the bird would come back so we ran home. My mom greeted us at the door. I thought we were safe but then we heard a knock. It was just the pizza man. We ate pizza and had fun.

It was February and it was freezing outside. My dog Max and I went for a walk on the trail. It started raining a little bit, but we kept walking. Max was sniffing a big pile of leaves. I thought he found a squirrel.

Suddenly, Max ran into the bushes and disappeared! I got scared because there might be danger in the woods.

"Max! Come back right now!" I yelled really loud.

I neared the bushes and my heart was pumping fast. I heard a noise like a bell ringing. It was Max's collar. He was just dumping dirt on a bone he found.

"You are a bad boy, Max," I said.

He looked happy. We walked home and he fell asleep fast. He was sleeping all night.

It was my best friend Sam’s birthday sleepover last Saturday. We planned to stay up all night and guard the snacks. Sam’s mom brewed some hot cocoa for us, though it was super hot. We spread out our sleeping bags in the living room. Suddenly, we realized the bag of chips was gone!

"We have to seize the thief!" I shouted loudly.

We looked everywhere and discovered my dog Buster in the corner. He had his head inside the bag. I screamed because it was so funny. Buster believed the chips were just for him. The bag did contain a lot of crumbs now. Our plan was a total failure, but we laughed anyway.

"Bad dog!" Sam said, but he petted Buster’s head.

We grabbed a newspaper to clean up the big mess. Next time, we will keep the snacks up high.
